title: The Traitors
description: Murder most foul continues, but this time the Traitors must kill in plain sight; a deadly mission sees a player take their last breath in the game; a dramatic round table leaves the next banishment hanging in the balance.

title: The Traitors
description: Alan's castle in the Scottish Highlands welcomes a new arrival; the Faithful have a cunning plan to fight back; one of the Traitors is in the hot seat.

title: The Traitors
description: With the Traitors having so far avoided detection, the Faithful finally have a chance to strike back; the treacherous trio starts to turn on each other and faces a difficult dilemma that could backfire.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description: A long-time resident of a suburban street descends into a morass of delusion, anger and paranoia that turns him against innocent neighbors; he eventually becomes wholly unhinged and unleashes his violent wrath upon his small Baltimore community.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description: A friendly retired couple delights a family with young children when they move in next door. Then the new neighbors' dog attacks the children's mother, setting off a vicious conflict that ends in two shocking murders.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description: A five-year relationship between neighbors falls apart when one borrows the other's lawnmower and supposedly returns it broken; camaraderie morphs into rage, threats, and physical violence until a bloody murder devastates the community.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description: A retired couple's golden years shatter when a troubled Army veteran moves in next door and makes their lives hell with his appalling behavior; they declare war, fighting vicious battles until one of these neighbors turns up dead.

title: Daddy's Home 2
description: Father and stepfather Dusty and Brad join forces to make Christmastime perfect for the children. Their newfound partnership soon gets put to the test when Dusty's old-school, macho dad and Brad's gentle father arrive to turn the holiday upside down. After a sudden change in plans, the four men decide to take the kids to a luxury resort for a fun-filled getaway that turns into a hilariously chaotic adventure.

title: A Christmas Mystery
description: A strip of Santa's jingle bells brings a century of peace and prosperity to a small town in Oregon, but they go missing just days before Christmas. A group of intrepid kids try to find the real thief, locate the bells and restore the Christmas magic after a friend's dad is falsely accused.

title: A Christmas Story Christmas
description: Ralphie reconnects with old friends when he returns to his childhood home in Indiana to give his kids a magical Christmas like the one he had growing up.

title: Christmas With the Kranks
description: Finally alone for the holidays, Luther (Tim Allen) and Nora Krank (Jamie Lee Curtis) plan to eschew the Christmas traditions and take a cruise in the Caribbean instead. This doesn't sit well with their Christmas-obsessed neighbors Vic Frohmeyer (Dan Aykroyd) and Walt Scheel (M. Emmet Walsh), who are determined to win the annual "best decorated street" competition, and the Kranks soon find themselves social outcasts because of their lack of Christmas spirit.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding 2
description: Parenting and marriage are becoming tougher and tougher for Toula and her husband Ian. Not only has their relationship lost some of its spark, but they're also dealing with a rebellious teenage daughter who clashes with Greek traditions. On top of that, Toula must contend with aging parents and the endless needs of cousins and friends. When a shocking family secret comes to light, the entire Portokalos clan makes plans to come together for an even bigger wedding than before.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding 3
description: Members of the Portokalos family reunite in Greece for a hilarious and heartwarming trip full of love, twists and turns.

title: Moonshot
description: In a future where Mars is terraformed, two college students sneak onboard a space shuttle from Earth to Mars to be united with their significant others.
